'''Electronic Countermeasures Suites''' were devices used to perform [[Electronic countermeasures/Legends|electronic countermeasures]]. [[Darvro-class light freighter|''Darvro''-class light freighters]] and [[Tallanx-class stealth fighter|''Tallanx''-class stealth fighters]] could both be modified with Electronic Countermeasures Suites.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
